title: WavePhaseNet: A DFT-Based Method for Constructing Semantic Conceptual Hierarchy Structures (SCHS)
abstract: arXiv:2602.14419v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper reformulates Transformer/Attention mechanisms in Large Language Models (LLMs) through measure theory and frequency analysis, theoretically demonstrating that hallucination is an inevitable structural limitation. The embedding space functions as a conditional expectation over a {\sigma}-algebra, and its failure to be isomorphic to the semantic truth set fundamentally causes logical consistency breakdown. WavePhaseNet Method The authors propose WavePhaseNet, which explicitly constructs a Semantic Conceptual Hierarchy Structure (SCHS) using Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT). By applying DFT along the sequence dimension, semantic information is decomposed into frequency bands: low-frequency components capture global meaning and intent, while high-frequency components represent local syntax and expression. translated_title: WavePhaseNet：一种基于DFT构建语义概念层级结构（SCHS）的方法
translated_abstract: 本文通过测度论和频率分析重新阐述了大型语言模型（LLMs）中的Transformer/注意力机制，从理论上证明了幻觉是不可避免的结构性限制。嵌入空间作为σ-代数上的条件期望，其与语义真值集非同构是导致逻辑一致性崩溃的根本原因。作者提出了WavePhaseNet方法，利用离散傅里叶变换（DFT）显式构建语义概念层级结构（SCHS）。通过沿序列维度应用DFT，语义信息被分解为频带：低频成分捕捉全局意义和意图，高频成分代表局部句法和表达。这种分段分离使得在对角化空间中能够进行精确的语义操作。在降维方面，GPT-4的24,576维嵌入空间被进一步优化。
tldr: 本文提出WavePhaseNet方法，利用离散傅里叶变换将语义分解为频带，显式构建语义概念层级结构，从理论上揭示了幻觉的结构性根源。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes WavePhaseNet, which uses DFT to decompose semantics into frequency bands and explicitly constructs a Semantic Conceptual Hierarchy Structure, theoretically revealing the structural root of hallucination.
